notes: Auth: the firebase CLI login (a project owner); security rules do not apply.
Times, durations, page tokens and transaction ids are replaced by placeholders (normalise in lib.mjs); everything else is as returned.

The fixture (setup) is one collection aruma-ref-f3-q with a field v of every type (null, false, true, NaN, -Infinity, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.0, a timestamp, "a", "b", bytes, a geopoint, an array, a map), k = 1..17 (nok has none), g in a/b/c, arr arrays; none has no v. Subcollections aruma-ref-f3-qcg under aruma-ref-f3-q/i1, aruma-ref-f3-r/x and the missing document aruma-ref-f3-q/ghost, and aruma-ref-f3-q/i1/aruma-ref-f3-qcg/c1/deep/y.
documents lists the names returned, in order (rel. to the documents root); elementKeys the keys of each stream element as received.
Cursors: startAt with before:true is startAt, before:false startAfter; endAt with before:false is endAt, before:true endBefore.
